name: Heavy Duty Industrial BOPP Brown Box Carton Packaging Tape (50mm x 65m)
shortDescription: High-tack 45-micron brown BOPP packaging tape with aggressive hot-melt adhesive for heavy corrugated box closure and tamper-evident warehouse sealing.
overview: Engineered for high-volume logistics hubs, industrial manufacturing dispatch bays, and e-commerce packaging stations, this heavy-duty brown BOPP tape guarantees structural carton integrity during transit. Extruded with a 28-micron high-tensile biaxially oriented polypropylene backing and coated with a 17-micron high-tack synthetic rubber adhesive, it delivers tremendous grab on virgin and recycled kraft corrugated board. The natural brown kraft color matches cardboard boxes perfectly, providing clean aesthetics and discreet, tamper-evident security.

Industrial export packing, container consolidation, and bundling
